# Grandad's Nods

*Robin knows every one of Osmund's nods but one: the nod he gave the badge. Robin wants the clangs cleared off the far bank where Osmund ties up, and asks you to ask his grandfather what else that nod meant.*

## Objectives

2. Talk to [Osmund](../npcs/osmund.md)
